title: Allied Op: Balance of Power
briefing:
Operation: Balance of Power - Location: Bordeaux, France

The Soviet forces somehow managed to capture several Trident Battleships and intend to use to defeat the Allies at the English Channel. A taskforce is sent to recapture them.

Objective 1: Repair the bridge and defend the outpost. Objective 2: Repel the Soviet counterattack. Objective 3: Clear the harbours and retake the Tridents.

title: Allied Op: Blut Royale
briefing:
Operation: Blut Royale - Location: Berlin, Germany

The evacuation of Berlin is almost complete, however the extraction of crucial data is prolonging its completion. A group of brave soldiers are staying behind to face the Soviets.

Objective 1: Defend the SteinsTech University.

title: Allied Op: Attack on Buggy
briefing:
Operation: Attack on Buggy - Location: Alcazaren, Spain

The Latin Confederation has reached Europe. They brought Bomb Buggies which can destroy vital Euro Alliance positions. They must be eliminated before they reach their targets.

Objective 1: Destroy all Bomb Buggies before they escape.

title: Allied Op: Downfall
briefing:
Operation: Downfall - Location: Upper Normandy, France

A large Soviet taskforce is on its way to support the attack on the Gladius System at the English Channel. Their advance must be stopped, else the Allies might lose the battle there.

Objective 1: Break the blockade and reach the outpost. Objective 2: Protect the Radar Dome until more forces arrive. Objective 3: Defend the outpost until more forces arrive.

title: Allied Op: Enforcers
briefing:
Operation: Enforcers - Location: Sousse, Tunisia

After the American bases in Africa were struck by rebels, the Soviets poisoned the water supplies of the remaining Allied forces. With what little they have, the Americans fight back.

Objective 1: Escort the MCV to the outpost in the south. Objective 2: Destroy the excavation site. Objective 3: Destroy all Soviet production.

title: Allied Op: Hypothermia
briefing:
Operation: Hypothermia - Location: San Juan, Puerto Rico

After the destruction of Yuri's Nuke Silo on Virgin Islands, a group of American survivors has decided to reveal themselves and send an S.O.S. signal. The Pacific Front sends help.

Obiective 1: Contact the American outpost. Objective 2: Protect the bridge and the Port Authority. Objective 3: Destroy the enemy bases.

title: Allied Op: Low Rider
briefing:
Operation: Low Rider - Location: Los Angeles, California

Defeated at the Mexico border, the Latin Confederation is deploying their forces from the sea. They have established two forward bases in Los Angeles that must be destroyed.

Objective 1: Destroy Latin Confederation forces in LA.

title: Allied Op: Mad Monster
briefing:
Operation: Mad Monster - Location: Masuria, Poland

As the Allies fall back to England, the Soviets plan to deploy Super Apocalypses to invade the British Isles. A covert team has been assembled to hack the remote-controlled vehicles.

Objective 1: Find the Spies. Objective 2: Sabotage the Advanced Radar Dishes. Objective 3: Destroy the Soviet Super Apocalypse Complex.

title: Allied Op: Panzer Ace
briefing:
Operation: Panzer Ace - Location: Bordeaux, France

The Soviets are assembling more Stalin's Fist Mobile War Factories around Europe, rapidly increasing their reach and production. A significant group of these must be destroyed.

Objective 1: Destroy the Soviet forces at the bridgehead. Objective 2: Protect the bridge from the Soviets. Objective 3: Destroy all of the Stalin's Fists in the area.

title: Allied Op: Impersonal War
briefing:
Operation: Impersonal War - Location: Athens, Greece

The Soviets are attacking Athens, home of veteran Nikos Stavros. He asks for deployment of a taskforce in Glyfada to destroy the Soviet base in Greece and retake the city.

Objective 1: Destroy all Russian forces in the city.

title: Allied Op: Good Old Times
briefing:
Operation: Good Old Times - Location: Tamaulipas, Mexico

The Confederation is producing even more white phosphorus, a substance they use to enhance their new flame weapons. The Allies must destroy the factories supplying the chemical.

Objective 1: Destroy all White Phosphorus Storage.

title: Allied Op: Technologic
briefing:
Operation: Technologic - Location: Zakopane, Poland

The Chinese research on nuclear weapons is progressing too fast and must be delayed. If they develop their equivalent of MIDAS bomb, the Allies will have no chance of fighting back.

Objective 1: Destroy the Chinese Atomhearts.

title: Epsilon Op: The Cardinal
briefing:
Operation: The Cardinal - Location: Rome, Italy

Yuri wants to bait the Europeans with a Psychic Amplifier construction in Rome. As the city is controlled by Russian forces, they must be turned to Yuri's command first.

Objective 1: Destroy the defenses around Basilica Objective 2: Destroy the Stalin's Fist. Objective 3: Defend the Psychic Amplifier until it's activated.

title: Epsilon Op: Metaphor
briefing:
Operation: Metaphor - Location: Leyte Gulf, Philippines

To deal with the threat of the Chinese, Rahn and his forces invade one of their newly established bases. Yuri hopes to acquire intel in order to learn about their new developments.

Objective 1: Get Rahn close to the Atomheart. Objective 2: Get Rahn to the Driller.

title: Epsilon Op: Backbitten
briefing:
Operation: Backbitten - Location: Ascension Island

PsiCorps is on the hunt for the Allies' ultimate weapon. While the vessel itself still can't be located, it appears that one of its Batteries is being powered on the Ascension Island.

Objective 1: Destroy all Lightning Rods. Objective 2: Infiltrate and then destroy the Paradox Battery.

title: Epsilon Op: Television Lies
briefing:
Operation: Television Lies - Location: Leninsk Cosmodrome

The Allied occupation intends to launch the first Russian TV satellite into space as a sign of good will. Yuri commands his psychic troops to smuggle additional hardware onboard.

Objective 1: Get an Engineer into Launchpad without killing.

title: Epsilon Op: Mind Over Matter
briefing:
Operation: Mind Over Matter - Location: Detroit, Michigan

PsiCorps is trying to resist the effects of now Soviet Psychic Amplifier in Chicago through the use of Psychic Beacons. The Soviets begin a powerful attack on one of the devices.

Objective 1: Destroy all Iron Curtain Devices. Objective 2: Protect the Psychic Beacon. Objective 3: Wait for further instructions.

title: Epsilon Op: Monochromatic
briefing:
Operation: Monochromatic - Location: Boston, Massachusetts

American remnants have obtained data of advanced equipment from the Allied flying fortress and captured a Psychic Beacon in Boston. The latest superweapon prototype is at stake.

Objective 1: Destroy the stolen Psychic Beacon. Objective 2: Defend the Psychic Dominator. Objective 3: Destroy the enemy forces.

title: Epsilon Op: Neuromancers
briefing:
Operation: Neuromancers - Location: Giza Governorate, Egypt

After the battle in Bissau, the captured rebels revealed the location, where the suspicious new toxin is produced. In the hands of the Scorpion Cell it is a threat to Yuri's forces.

Objective 1: Destroy Pandora Hubs and all Neurotoxin Vats. Objective 2: Destroy all Bloatick Tunnels.

title: Epsilon Op: Brain Reset
briefing:
Operation: Brain Reset - Location: Primorsky Krai, Russia

The Russians still have access to mind control tech. One of their Palaces, an access point for their Weapons Protocol is within PsiCorps' reach, but the Chinese aim to destroy it.

Objective 1: Defend the Palace until the hack is complete.

title: Epsilon Op: Rainmaker
briefing:
Operation: Rainmaker - Location: Allenbach, Germany

The Euro Alliance is working on a weapon that'd allow them to control the weather. This would give them an advantage over the Russians, which wouldn't coincide with Yuri's plans.

Objective 1: Destroy all 4 Weather Crystals.

title: Epsilon Op: Retaliation
briefing:
Operation: Retaliation - Location: Tiaret, Algeria

The Americans are retaliating after the attack on the embassy in Egypt. Rashidi wants to show Yuri that they understand the risks taken and are prepared to face the consequences.

Objective 1: Destroy the American pursuers.

title: Epsilon Op: Rush Tactics
briefing:
Operation: Rush Tactics - Location: Gangwon, South Korea

The Pacific Front is deploying their new Hailstorm artillery weapon in the Korean war zone. This could give them a major edge over their enemies, ending the conflict preemptively.

Objective 1: Intercept and destroy all Hailstorms.

title: Epsilon Op: Research Stroke
briefing:
Operation: Research Stroke - Location: Guangzhou, China

The Chinese continue to benefit from the latest technological achievements of the Kanegawa Industries, as they now have several new facilities in their lands. Yuri wants them gone.

Objective 1: Destroy the Kanegawa Assembly. Objective 2: Destroy the Industrial Plants.

title: Soviet Op: Burned Alive
briefing:
Operation: Burned Alive - Location: Dalnegorsk, Russia

The Pacific Front has attacked Russia in two places at once. Vladivostok held, Dalnegorsk has fallen. A brave group of Pyros wish to purge the enemy, but they need commanders.

Objective 1: Destroy the Pacific Front base in Dalnegorsk.

title: Soviet Op: Combustion
briefing:
Operation: Combustion - Location: Montpellier, France

While the Allies were battling the Soviets in Southern France, they took control over a massive napalm storage unit. Morales and two Confederation taskforces are sent to recover it.

Objective 1: Rendezvous both teams. Objective 2: Secure the Napalm Storage location. Objective 3: Extract the supplies.

title: Soviet Op: Cyberanatomy
briefing:
Operation: Cyberanatomy - Location: Xinjiang, China

Shortly after an attempt to reform the Soviet alliance, Reznov and Krukov receive a worrisome message from an agent deep within the Chinese lands about suspicious activity in Xinjiang.

Objective 1: Contact the agent. Objective 2: Follow the agent's instructions. Objective 3: Evacuate Reznov and Krukov.

title: Soviet Op: Ego Ergo Hax
briefing:
Operation: Ego Ergo Hax - Location: Black Forest, Germany

At third facility, SteinsTech is nearing the completion of their next-gen Chronosphere prototype. The Chinese attempt to slow its development down by sending Yunru in to hack it.

Objective 1: Escort Yunru to the Chronosphere. Objective 2: Get Yunru to the extraction point.

title: Soviet Op: Lights Out
briefing:
Operation: Lights Out - Location: Rosendal, Norway

The Allies have three major facilities the Soviets plan to strike. The first is a research complex where the next generation of Gap Generators is being tested and produced.

Objective 1: Destroy 3 enhanced Gap Generators. Objective 2: Destroy the Euro Alliance forces.

title: Soviet Op: Needlehead
briefing:
Operation: Needlehead - Location: Seattle, Washington

After a series of victorious battles, the Latin Confederation aims to conquer the city of Seattle next, to secure the West Coast. Heavy taskforces are sent to take control of the area.

Objective 1: Destroy the American forces in Seattle.

title: Soviet Op: Ravages of War
briefing:
Operation: Ravages of War - Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

By taking out the Allied forces in Copenhagen, the Soviets intend to weaken their navy on the Baltic. With many parts of the city already under their control, they plan a final strike.

Objective 1: Hold the line. Objective 2: Clear the path and deploy a base at the coast. Objective 3: Destroy the Allied forces in the city.

title: Soviet Op: Repentance
briefing:
Operation: Repentance - Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands

The Allies are preparing the fleet in Amsterdam to support the defense of the English Channel. The Soviets plan to destroy their Naval Shipyards in a surprise attack within the city.

Objective 1: Destroy the Euro Alliance naval base.

title: Soviet Op: Role Reversal
briefing:
Operation: Role Reversal - Location: Muros, Spain

The Latin Confederation is commencing its attack on Europe from the west. They must clear the shore to make way for approaching transports, so that Spain is within their grasp.

Objective 1: Destroy the Euro Alliance forces in the region.

title: Soviet Op: Money Source
briefing:
Operation: Money Source - Location: Rabat, Morocco

To collect more resources, the Confederation heads to Rabat, where the largest American base in Morocco is. They intend to seize their ore mining sites before the Scorpion Cell does.

Objective 1: Destroy both Allied Tech Centers. Objective 2: Destroy the Ore Purifiers.

title: Soviet Op: Thunder God
briefing:
Operation: Thunder God - Location: Angermanland, Sweden

The second facility, a Thor Gunship production site has been located by the Soviets. The Allies are working on a new prototype of Thor that poses a major threat to the Soviets.

Objective 1: Destroy all Super Thors and Allied War Factories.

title: Soviet Op: Intoxicated
briefing:
Operation: Intoxicated - Location: Zaragoza, Spain

An unusual activity has been observed in what used to be one of the Soviet bases in Spain after it has been raided by Yuri's commandos. Reznov and Krukov are sent to investigate.

Objective 1: Find and eliminate the source of the infections. Objective 2: Kill all hostiles.
